mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_watch_item (symbol, market, stock_name, image_url, enabled, source) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{market}, #{stockName}, #{imageUrl}, #{enabled}, #{source})
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_watch_item SET stock_name = #{stockName}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, enabled = #{enabled}, source = #{source}, gmt_modify = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM stock_watch_item WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY gmt_create ASC, id ASC
